title: Kagamine Rin — Cupid Of Friendship〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow! You were 100% right, Len!
Nene's an amazing singer!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She was already amazing when we sang together before, but she's only gotten better since then!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know, right? I really wanted you to see the Christmas show too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It was so hard to get a hold of you.
You just wouldn't stay in one place.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's because there were so many things I wanted to see♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But you know what...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Teehee☆ I discovered something even more awesome♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hi, Nene♪ Have a nice chat with Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu gave me some tickets for the Phoenix Wonderland earlier...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I don't have any use for them, so I gave them to Tsukasa. There were four, and he said he could have his sister and her friends visit us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really?
That's so nice of you, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I really didn't mean anything by that...
Anyway, did you want something from me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, right☆ I wanted to tell you that your singing was just SUPERB!♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um... Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm? What are you looking at, Nene? I'm over here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(What's she doing? She turned away again...
There's just stage equipment over there.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(Is this some sort of a game?
Hehe♪ I'll get her to look at me!
Let's try from that side next!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Eek! Listen, Rin...
I don't like being stared at that much...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What? Wasn't this your game?
Did I get the rules wrong?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Rules...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha! Nene's just really shy around people, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? H-Hey...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
She doesn't know you all that well yet,
so she just feels a little nervous.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I didn't know!
But I want to become friends with you, Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And I want to sing with you too♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sing with me...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! Is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's not that I don't want to...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right, you don't like eye contact. But if I'm not facing you, you'll be okay with talking to me, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So I'll stand... Right behind you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This works, right? You can't see my eyes now!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha! That's funny! My turn now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Oh, what are you guys playing? It looks fun!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Let us play with you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Sure!
Come on, join in♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-No, wait...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay team, break's over...
Hm?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, you all seem to be getting along nicely...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-This isn't funny! H-Help!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Sigh... That's it for today's practice...
I didn't get to sing with Nene at all...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Don't worry, you can try again another day!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, hi...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh! Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I, um... I've been practicing my singing at home and in the park...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But when it's just me on my own, I can't tell what I could improve. It would be helpful to have someone come and listen to me...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I agree! But who are you gonna ask?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Rin, you dummy.
She's asking YOU!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You don't have to if you don't want...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, no! I'd love to!
I love your singing sooo much!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, I plan on practicing at my local park tomorrow evening, so do you think you could...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! Of course! I can't wait, Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll see you tomorrow evening! I'm so excited!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Good for you, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks for helping me break the ice with Nene!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm really want to be good friends with her, so we can sing together lots and lots!
